title: D06 regolith and surface-property measurement semantics
scope: Particle size, bulk density, porosity, cohesion, friction angle and bearing strength. Earth predictions from SoilGrids 2.0 are evidence-only model output; Moon and Mars have no registered real sample/measurement source in this repository.
principles: A model prediction is not a measurement; every observation states which one it is.
Depth support is mandatory and per observation; different depths are never averaged, pooled or scored as one feature.
A measured physical zero is a value; missing, not detected, no coverage and not applicable are separate states and never zero-filled.
A particle-size distribution keeps its bin edges, bin basis (mass, volume or number) and depth.
Experiment-derived strength properties keep gravity, moisture, load geometry, failure criterion and sample state.
Moon and Mars regolith values are no_coverage until a real public sample or PDS measurement is registered.
No regolith property is derived from DEM roughness, slope, land-cover bare fraction or Earth SoilGrids transfer.

depth_policy.surface_semantics: kind=surface means a sample interface with no measured thickness; it is not a depth interval and is not comparable to one.

variables.label: Particle size distribution

bins.normalization: fractions are within [0, 1] and sum to 1 within 1e-6
bins.usda_note: The default USDA texture edges are clay <2 um, silt 2-50 um, sand 50-2000 um. Other published schemes must record their own edges.

variables.measured_evidence: Sieve/laser/hydrometer sample measurement with sample ID, method and depth.
variables.earth_note: SoilGrids supplies clay, sand and silt mass fractions (g kg-1) as separate model predictions; this pilot does not convert them into a normalized distribution.
variables.not_observed_reason: No public lunar or Martian particle-size sample measurement is registered.
forbidden_derivations: DEM roughness or slope to grain size
land-cover bare fraction to grain size
SoilGrids Earth texture transferred to Moon or Mars

variables.label: Bulk density
variables.measured_evidence: Mass/volume sample measurement or geotechnical in-situ test with depth and sample state.
variables.earth_note: SoilGrids bdod is bulk density of the fine earth fraction in cg cm-3, a model prediction, not a local sample. It excludes coarse fragments and is not the total bulk density of a rocky regolith.
variables.not_observed_reason: No public lunar or Martian bulk-density measurement is registered; thermal inertia is not converted without a verified physical model.
forbidden_derivations: thermal inertia to bulk density without a verified model
porosity to bulk density without a stated grain density
Earth SoilGrids values transferred to Moon or Mars

variables.label: Porosity
variables.measured_evidence: Pore-volume measurement with sample state, depth, pore definition and uncertainty.
variables.earth_note: No porosity product is ingested; SoilGrids does not publish porosity. It must not be inferred from bdod without a stated particle density.
variables.not_observed_reason: No public porosity measurement with pore definition and depth is registered.
forbidden_derivations: 1 - bulk_density/2650 without a stated and justified particle density
DEM roughness or radar roughness to porosity

variables.label: Cohesion
variables.measured_evidence: Direct shear or triaxial experiment with stated conditions.
variables.earth_note: No cohesion experiment table is ingested for these AOIs.
variables.not_observed_reason: No public lunar or Martian cohesion experiment with stated conditions is registered.
forbidden_derivations: slope angle or DEM-derived slope stability to cohesion
Earth SoilGrids texture to cohesion without a verified pedotransfer function

variables.label: Friction angle
variables.measured_evidence: Direct shear or triaxial experiment with stated conditions.
variables.earth_note: No friction-angle experiment table is ingested for these AOIs.
variables.not_observed_reason: No public lunar or Martian friction-angle experiment is registered.
forbidden_derivations: DEM slope angle to internal friction angle
angle of repose assumed from a landform class

variables.label: Bearing strength
variables.measured_evidence: Penetrometer, plate load or cone penetration test with stated conditions.
variables.earth_note: No bearing-strength test table is ingested for these AOIs.
variables.not_observed_reason: No public lunar or Martian bearing-strength measurement is registered.
forbidden_derivations: DEM-derived terrain trafficability score presented as bearing strength
rover wheel slip or slope to bearing strength without calibration

Earth.note: Five AOIs only; not global coverage and not local measurements.

Moon.note: No public lunar sample or PDS regolith measurement is registered. No value is estimated from a DEM.

Mars.note: No public Mars PDS regolith measurement is registered. No value is estimated from a DEM.

references: Poggio et al. 2021, SoilGrids 2.0, SOIL 7, 217-240, https://doi.org/10.5194/soil-7-217-2021
USDA soil texture classes, Soil Survey Manual
